title: Takes Up Too Much Space; Wastes Some Dishwashing Liquid
text:
Takes Up Too Much Space; Wastes Some Dishwashing Liquid. This OXO GOOD GRIPS SOAP DISPENSING SPONGE HOLDER is one of the few OXO products that I don’t like. The tall (3½” high) holder is the size of a small dishwashing sponge, and it takes up too much space alongside my sink. All the holder does is squirt a tiny amount of dishwashing liquid onto the bottom of a sponge when you press the holder down.

It’s easier for me to squirt the dishwashing liquid onto the sponge directly from the bottle. Stored in a conventional flat soap dish, the sponge is easier to pick up.

Also, there’s some waste of dishwashing liquid when you use the soap dispensing holder. You have to fill the lower reservoir with dishwashing liquid, and because this is a pump dispenser, some of the liquid will always be left behind.

The soap reservoir can't be cleaned easily, because it is welded to the white part that contains the pump mechanism. (You can clean the reservoir by filling it full of water instead of soap, but the reservoir is hard to empty.)

Of course, the holder dispenses a measured amount of dishwashing liquid. You may save on dishwashing liquid if you, or someone in your household, always tends to squirt too much liquid from the bottle.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Stainless Steel Soap Dispensing Sponge Holder - Clear, One Size
features: Drip tray catches water and holder keeps sponges elevated for quick drying
Convenient soap storage eliminates messy bottles on your countertop
Comes apart for easy, thorough cleaning
description: Bring an end to messy soap bottles on your countertop with the OXO Good Grips Soap Dispensing Sponge Holder. Get soap on demand with an easy, one-handed press. The ventilated, elevated Holder promotes quick drying, while the drip tray catches excess water from sponges. With an internal soap cap that prevents water from mixing into dish soap, and a clear body that shows when it’s time for a refill. The Holder comes apart for thorough cleaning.
